units.id: start:default|description|19|0
units.english: You grew up on New Boston, an uninteresting world in the Dirt Belt. You've dreamed of owning a starship ever since your first visit to the spaceport. After years of working at a textile mill, you've saved enough credits to apply for a pilot's license from the Republic. Now you must take out a loan on your first ship...
units.raw: description `You grew up on New Boston, an uninteresting world in the Dirt Belt. You've dreamed of owning a starship ever since your first visit to the spaceport. After years of working at a textile mill, you've saved enough credits to apply for a pilot's license from the Republic. Now you must take out a loan on your first ship...`

units.id: start:default|description|20|0
units.english: This is the classic Endless Sky experience. You will begin in debt, and must use your new starship to pay off your mortgage.

units.id: conversation:default intro|log|74|0

units.id: conversation:default intro|log|77|0
units.english: The Syndicate is a megacorporation, the largest employer in human space. People who cannot find steady work elsewhere flock to the Syndicate factory worlds, where they are almost guaranteed to find a job. Although the Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, Syndicate worlds are governed directly by the corporation.

units.id: conversation:default intro|The bank's architecture is what you would have called "futuristic" back when you dreamed that the future would be less squalid than the present: story above story of curves and spires and balconies, all in gleaming metal. units.id: conversation:default intro|	The pen is heavy as lead but glides almost without friction as you print your initials on the bottom of page after page of ominous legal documents and sign several dozen statements, notices, and agreements. The banker, a balding middle-aged man in a suit that you suspect costs more than the spaceship you are about to purchase, flips the pages past you quickly, uttering a curt, "Sign here. units.id: start:deep|description|94|0
units.english: You grew up on Midgard, a world in the advanced Deep region. Most pursue higher education, but you've always wanted to be a starship captain. After finishing primary education, you learn that the Deep provides low-interest loans for prospecting captains with high enough grades, and you made the mark! You make your way to the capital city of New Reykjavik...
units.raw: description `You grew up on Midgard, a world in the advanced Deep region. Most pursue higher education, but you've always wanted to be a starship captain. You make your way to the capital city of New Reykjavik...`

units.id: conversation:deep intro|	Before long, you arrive in New Reykjavik at the government office responsible for handling starship loans. The reception is buzzing with activity as other fresh-faced graduates chat among themselves while waiting for their turn. Sunlight falls through the slitted ceiling windows onto a three-dimensional representation of the Deep's insignia in the lobby's center, a red tree with branches forming the shape of a brain. A circle of text surrounds the sculpture, proclaiming the Deep's core values: Peace. Prosperity. Progress.|124|0

units.id: conversation:deep intro|	You insert the card into an automatic clerk at the bank, and after a soft ping, a large document fills its screen. units.id: conversation:deep intro|	You rush out of the bank and hop on the metro towards the shipyard. As the rest of the carriage look blankly out the windows and at their devices, you are barely able to keep a straight face, flipping over your pilot's license at least a hundred times before the ride is over. You consider throwing away your transport pass as soon as you get off, but change your mind at the last minute. There won't be much else tying you to this planet soon.|129|0

units.id: conversation:deep intro|	You had pored over footage of New Reykjavik's shipyard in your younger days, but seeing the place in-person blows your wildest expectations out of the water. Salespeople use holographic displays to showcase a variety of vessels to sharply-dressed clients while skyscraper-sized ships loom silently in the shadows of the yard, waiting for the wealthiest of merchants to claim them. Although most of the ships are far outside of your price range, you spot four models that you'll be able to purchase. Which one you choose will determine your future...|130|0
